figures.name: Unkulunkulu

ability.name: Reed of Creation
ability.description: When played, all allies enter with +2 to all stats from the first creation.

figures.description: The supreme creator who emerged from a bed of reeds and broke off the first people and cattle from the reeds.

figures.name: Inkosazana

ability.name: Princess of Heaven
ability.description: Restore 4 HP to all allies; all nature and earth allies gain +2 defense.

figures.description: Beautiful princess of heaven who sits in mists above rivers and teaches women the arts of agriculture.

figures.name: Inkanyamba

ability.name: Tornado Serpent
ability.description: Deal 5 damage to all enemies; create a storm effect lasting 2 turns.

figures.description: Enormous feathered or horse-headed serpent that creates storms, floods and whirlwinds when angered.

figures.name: Tokoloshe

ability.name: Ankle Biter
ability.description: Reduce one enemy's defense to zero for 1 turn from the creature gnawing.

figures.description: Small hairy malevolent water sprite summoned by witches to harm enemies, feared throughout Southern Africa.

figures.name: Umlungu

ability.name: Ancestor Strike
ability.description: Deal 4 damage and place an ancestral curse: enemy loses 1 stat per turn for 2 turns.

figures.description: The sky ancestor who communicates through lightning and whose anger or blessing determines events.

figures.name: Nomkhubulwane

ability.name: Rainbow Daughter
ability.description: Grant all allies immunity to drought and fire effects for 2 turns.

figures.description: Daughter of the sky who appears as a rainbow to bring rain and fertility to the parched earth.

figures.name: Mamlambo

ability.name: Brain Drain
ability.description: Reduce one enemy's wisdom to 1 permanently; that enemy cannot use magic abilities.

figures.description: Brain-eating river creature of terrifying beauty that glows green and emerges at night to attack humans.

figures.name: Thikoloshe

ability.name: Witch's Errand
ability.description: Steal one buff from an enemy and deliver it to any ally.

figures.description: Shape-shifting familiar spirit that witches dispatch to cause illness, bad luck and mischief for enemies.

figures.name: Hili

ability.name: Sky Cannibal
ability.description: Attack one enemy from above ignoring all ground defenses.

figures.description: Fearsome flying cannibals who swoop from the sky and were among the most feared creatures in Zulu belief.

figures.name: Izulu

ability.name: Heavenly Force
ability.description: All sky and storm allies gain +3 power for 1 turn.

figures.description: The cosmic heavenly realm itself personified as a spiritual force governing all things above.

figures.name: Abathakathi

ability.name: Witchcraft
ability.description: Inflict a random debuff on one enemy that lasts until dispelled.

figures.description: Dark sorcerers who work harm through night-magic and must be counteracted by the isangoma diviner.

figures.name: Isangoma

ability.name: Bone Throw
ability.description: Reveal all hidden enemy abilities; remove one debuff from all allies.

figures.description: The Zulu diviner-healer who communicates with ancestors by throwing bones to diagnose illness and misfortune.

figures.name: Sangoma Snake

ability.name: Ancestor Coil
ability.description: When this card heals an ally, also grant that ally +1 to their highest stat.

figures.description: The ancestral snake familiar of the isangoma who brings healing wisdom from the ancestors.

figures.name: Lightning Bird (Impundulu)

ability.name: Thunder Talon
ability.description: Deal 5 electric damage to one enemy; 50% chance to stun.

figures.description: Supernatural lightning bird bound to witches that strikes with thunderbolts and craves human blood.

figures.name: Ndlovu (Divine Elephant)

ability.name: Never Forgotten
ability.description: This card cannot be debuffed by memory or wisdom reduction effects.

figures.description: The sacred elephant whose great strength, intelligence and memory make it a divine messenger.

figures.name: Umdlebe Tree

ability.name: Poison Shade
ability.description: All enemies resting in shade positions lose 2 HP per turn.

figures.description: The poisonous shade-tree that kills all who sleep beneath it, used in dark witchcraft.

figures.name: Amadlozi

ability.name: Ancestral Voice
ability.description: Grant one ally foreknowledge: they dodge the next attack aimed at them.

figures.description: The collective ancestor spirits who intercede between the living and Unkulunkulu, protecting their descendants.

figures.name: Uthikoloshe

ability.name: Night Fear
ability.description: Inflict fear on one enemy: they cannot attack for 1 turn.

figures.description: River sprite that terrifies children and was placed so high on beds that Tokoloshe could not reach sleepers.

figures.name: Umvelinqangi

ability.name: Primal Thunder
ability.description: Deal 4 damage to all enemies simultaneously.

figures.description: The primordial being who existed before Unkulunkulu, manifesting as thunder and governing the heavens.

figures.name: Nandi

ability.name: Iron Will
ability.description: This card cannot be debuffed or charmed; grant +2 power to one warrior ally.

figures.description: Mother of Shaka Zulu elevated to near-divine status whose fierce love shaped the greatest Zulu king.
